dimensions.name: STAR structure
dimensions.description: Situation, task, action and result let an interviewer follow your story and judge it.

levels.3: A story with one or two STAR parts missing or thin.
levels.5: Clear situation, task, action and result in proportion.

dimensions.name: Personal ownership
dimensions.description: Interviewers are hiring you, not your team, so they need to hear what you personally did.

levels.1: Only 'we', or the candidate's role is unclear.
levels.3: Some personal actions, mixed with team credit.
levels.5: Explicit about the candidate's own decisions and actions.

dimensions.name: Result and impact
dimensions.description: A result shows that your actions mattered; numbers make it credible.

levels.5: A clear, measured outcome and what was learned.

dimensions.name: Judgement
dimensions.description: How you weighed options shows how you will behave in new situations.

levels.5: Considers alternatives and explains why the chosen action was right.
